jobs.name: stalls
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite source sheet for Trætoppen's seasonal festival decorations.
Image 1 is the approved painted wood/cloth style. Image 2 is the approved painted city: use its honey timber, sage cloth, cream paper, muted lavender, terracotta, dull brass and small sky-blue accents. Image 3 establishes the friendly character world; do not draw characters.
Matte storybook gouache and watercolor with fine irregular warm grey-brown pencil contours, visible paper/brush texture, tactile organic slightly worn materials, soft daylight. No plastic CG, photorealism, vector-flat shapes, pixel art or harsh black outlines. No effigies, faces, animals or people. Do not draw text, numbers, lettering, labels, logos or watermarks.
Orthographic isometric camera elevated 36 degrees, upright verticals, floor axes at +30.7 and -30.7 degrees. Every object fully visible and separate with true transparent RGBA outside the paint. No background, floor, room, scenery, gradient, checkerboard or cast shadow. Strict equal grid cells: every object including rope, ribbon, feet and flowers fits entirely inside its own cell with at least 40 px transparent gutters on all sides.
Create FOUR ROWS by FOUR COLUMNS, 16 separate drawings, square 2048 x 2048. Each row has four true quarter-turns of the SAME 2 by 2 cell market stall: r0 front-right, r1 front-left, r2 rear-left, r3 rear-right. Preserve the same physical post structure and cloth; rear views show the closed timber back and rear canvas seam, never duplicate the front counter or mirror an image.
Shared structure: short friendly honey-timber booth, four posts, pitched canvas awning with small scalloped hem, low front counter with a few unlabelled jars or folded cloth, no tall signs. Compact enough to keep the stall's real 2 by 2 footprint.
Row 1 SPRING: muted sage and cream striped awning, small white blossom garland, tiny terracotta flowerpot.
Row 2 SUMMER: dusty sky-blue and warm cream striped canvas, little amber honey jars and restrained lavender ribbon.
Row 3 AUTUMN: muted terracotta and cream awning, tied wheat and a small orange pumpkin.
Row 4 WINTER: faded lavender and cream canvas, small evergreen sprig, warm amber lantern under the awning; no deep snow base or painted glow halo.

jobs.name: poles
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Derive ONLY the eight seasonal banner poles from the attached accepted painted sheet. Preserve their exact four seasonal identities, cloth colors, blossom/sun/leaf/snowflake emblems, honey timber, soft warm pencil and matte gouache/watercolor texture. Do not include any wreaths in the output.
Create FOUR ROWS and TWO COLUMNS, eight separate objects, portrait 1536 x 3072: spring, summer, autumn, winter from top to bottom; front-right and front-left authored orientations in the two columns, same physical object in each pair, no mirrored substitute.
Change the proportions to TALL SLENDER freestanding festival masts suitable for supporting lantern ropes over chibi characters: overall height at least 3.5 TIMES its widest base/banner width. Most of the height is a long visible thin wooden shaft. The cloth banner hangs only in the TOP THIRD of the shaft on a SHORT crossbar. A small low weighted timber cross base supports it; a little brass loop immediately below the top finial allows a rope to attach. Keep the flag narrow, keep the same accepted seasonal emblem design, and use only tiny restrained seasonal sprigs near the top, not a wide plant column. The top is higher than a chibi person's head plus the depth of a dangling lantern. No characters drawn.
Orthographic isometric camera 36 degrees with upright vertical poles. Every full pole, base and cloth inside its equal-sized cell, with at least 40 px transparent gutters all around. True transparent RGBA background, no floor, room, scenery, gradient, cast shadow, checkerboard, text, numbers, logos or watermark.
